notes.title: Quest of Souls Update - We're working on it!
notes.content:
Hello everybody!

We are still working on Quest of Souls...just slowly. ːsoloskullː

We've been taking on client work to pay the bills and will be able to dedicate more resources to Quest of Souls in the upcoming months when that finishes up.

Our team will provide more details as soon as we finish Necroball and launch that out of Early Access in Q1 of 2018.

If you'd like to support our game development, please grab a copy of Necroball!

http://store.steampowered.com/app/563410/Necroball/
Necroball started off as a mini-game in Quest of Souls and gained a life of its own after showing it at conventions like PAX South. We've learned a lot about mechanics, user experience, and Unity while making Necroball a finished product and we will use all that we've learned to improve Quest of Souls as we pick up the torch again.

Thanks for supporting us along the way.

-King Crow Studios
ːkingcrowːːflameyskullːːsoloskullːːnecropalmːːratbuddyː

notes.title: Quest of Souls Update 1/17/17
notes.content:
Hello Everybody!

It has been a while, but here is the latest update on how the development of Quest of Souls is going over here at King Crow Studios.

As you all may know, we tried our hand at a Kickstarter to fund the rest of development for Quest of Souls, but didn't meet our goal of $42,000.

Since then, our team has been working on turning the Quest of Souls mini-game, Necroball, into a standalone game that can help us develop Quest of Souls in more ways than one. It has provided a place for us to really fine-tune our multiplayer mechanics, animations, and "game feel" for Quest of Souls and it even exists in the same universe so you can play characters like Brunhilde the Good Lich or Zuzu the Demonologist.

http://store.steampowered.com/app/563410/

In addition to that, not only does Necroball help us develop QoS technically if you purchase a copy of Necroball the proceeds go toward finishing Necroball AND developing Quest of Souls!

If you like the way Quest of Souls looks and plays, then hopefully you'll love Necroball and what we've been able to do with it in Early Access.

Please stay tuned for monthly updates in the QoS Steam Discussion, as we continue to work on QoS throughout the year and release it getting closer to the end of 2017.

Thank you all for your interest and support for Quest of Souls!

-King Crow Studios
